notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). Read-only (allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob) guide for analysing user-supplied security logs: log-source taxonomy, Windows/Sysmon event IDs, Linux auth log patterns, baselining and correlation, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK v16 and NIST SP 800-92.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access; it explicitly forbids executing commands found in logs, fetching URLs from logs, or modifying/deleting log configuration, and tells the agent to redact credentials found in log data.
